observed_patterns_used: cards elevadas, testimonials y navegación sticky/fixed
variables CSS de color y tipografía similares al sistema Gravity
source_analysis.contrast_policy: AA/AAA-first: body text 7:1 target, CTA text >= 4.5:1

contrast_report.wcag_note: Valores >= 4.5 son AA para texto normal; bg_text apunta a >= 7 cuando el palette lo permite.

design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #FEF8F5; --surface: #FFFFFF; --surface-alt: #F1E5E0; --text: #23161A; --muted: #574148; --primary: #8A1238; --accent: #0F766E; --on-primary: #FFFFFF; --on-accent: #FFFFFF; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 6px; --gap: 40px; --blur: 22px; --nav-position: fixed; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Libre Baskerville', serif; } .editorial-flow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, .34fr) 1fr; gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); } .editorial-flow h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5.5rem); line-height: .92; letter-spacing: -.06em; } .article-card { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-block: 28px; }  @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
